info.title: FestOS API
info.description: Internal command centre for the Aarohan fest (EPINOIA 2026, IIM Indore)

get.description: List all contingents with declared vs actual strength and leader/escort statuses.
Retrieve basic profile details for a contingent.
Retrieve full operational view: attendance, travel windows, events, diet, merchandise, and housing.
List, filter, and fuzzy search canonical participants.

post.description: Register a new participant through ChangeService.

get.description: Retrieve single participant profile with role-based field masking.
360-degree operational view aggregating contingent, events, diet, accessibility, merch, and status.

post.description: Transition participant status through ChangeService (publishes participant.status_changed on bus).

get.description: Retrieve chronological audit events and mutation history for participant.
Returns the comprehensive counts panel and reconciliation waterfall explaining numbers.
List duplicate candidates filtered by confidence classification or status.
Side-by-side comparison of two participant records including registrations and claims.

post.description:
Merge duplicate participant into canonical participant via ChangeService.
Blocks if both records hold conflicting merchandise claims.
Reverts a merge operation, restoring byte-identical pre-merge state to both records.
Dismiss a candidate pair with a recorded reason not to merge.

get.description: Retrieve chronological merge and revert history.
Returns operational edge-case flags (same name different people, leaders competing, staff as participants).
Retrieve the operational unknown fields queue ranked by Count x Criticality.
Query individual participant records that have an UNKNOWN value for a specific field.

post.description: Record a verified field value through ChangeService.
Issue a cryptographically signed, field-scoped expiring confirmation token.
Public / semi-public endpoint to submit verified field value using signed token.
